mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing primidone metabolism and affecting anticonvulsant levels, while also increasing bleeding risk through platelet inhibition.
action: Monitor anticonvulsant efficacy and seizure control; consider INR monitoring if patient on concurrent anticoagulants; counsel on consistent turmeric dosing to avoid fluctuating primidone levels.
